name: MFP repeater transmitter
family: Context Plus MFP Range Conventional Panels
summary: The Repeater of the Context Plus MFP panel is implemented by installing a Repeater Transmitter PCB (Part No. FF596T) in the MFP Main panel. This PCB handles the two wire communications network to the Repeaters.
description: Each Repeater consists of a Main Receiver PCB which connects to the 2 wire network. This PCB has the Fault LEDs and controls and also incorporates the Fire Zone LEDs for the first eight zones. The Repeater panel is expanded in multiples of eight by installing 8 Zone Extender PCBs (Part No. FF596R), up to a maximum of 32 zone. The Repeater Transmitter PCB is mounted on, and takes its control signals and power from, the Main Control PCB which is mounted in the MFP Main panel. It drives the Repeaters over the two wire network.
